MD + MM-GBSA performed; 3 x 100 ns replicates with independent starting velocities. Docked pose retained for the full run in 1 of 3 replicates (lost at 8.0 and 21.1 ns in the others); 43% of total simulated time in contact with pocket 4.

warnings: MD and MM-GBSA performed for pyrene and phenanthrene only.

MD run in triplicate. The docked pose in pocket 4 is metastable: pyrene retains it for the full 100 ns in 2 of 3 replicates, phenanthrene in 1 of 3. A single trajectory is not sufficient to characterise it.
MM-GBSA over the replicate in which both ligands remained bound for the full run gives pyrene -28.43 +/- 3.73 and phenanthrene -18.71 +/- 3.06 kcal/mol (500 frames), reproducing the Vina ordering.
Kd values derived from the earlier single-replicate MM-GBSA are withdrawn; those windows sampled the ligand after it had left the pocket.
notes: Binding site proposed as canonical binding_site.yaml value; not yet formally adopted.
